description: The chart illustrates the runtime comparison of various models in a streaming environment, displaying the runtime in seconds for different models. The horizontal axis lists the model categories, namely "Our Joint Framework", "ChatGPT", "DeepSeek", "LLaMA", and "Claude", while the vertical axis represents the runtime in seconds, ranging from 0 to 400 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 50. The bars are colored according to the legend, with "Our Joint Framework" represented by a green bar and "LLM Models" represented by light blue bars. The green bar for "Our Joint Framework" has a value of 77 seconds, while the light blue bars have values of 190, 365, 172, and 243 seconds for "ChatGPT", "DeepSeek", "LLaMA", and "Claude", respectively. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and the categories are listed in a particular sequence on the horizontal axis. The chart does not display any specific visual emphasis on the bars, but the values are annotated above each bar.
